name: Visvam Srinivasan
belief: I believe the best work comes from being curious, staying kind, and caring about the details.
artCaption: A little intention goes a long way.
intro: I make useful things for the web, with a focus on clear thinking and thoughtful details.
about: I am a Final-Year B.E. CSE student at College of Engineering Guindy, Anna University. I am currently exploring the world of embedded software, low-level code, machine learning and AI and something I have started now - Robotics!

I actively work on new projects, learning more about the entire engineering process. As the current Chairperson at ACM-CEG, my team and I are instilling curisity for computers amongst the students of CEG through events, sessions, mentorship programs, etc.
Outside of academics, projects and club work, you will find me making music, designing, cycling and hitting the gym.
